newsitem.title: USA: Footstar begins trading on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: Footstar begins trading on NYSE.

text.p: Footstar Inc, which was formed by the spinoff of Melville Corp's footwear businesses, said on Monday today began trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "FTS" on a when issued basis.

Footstar is composed of Meldisco, a leading operator of leased footwear departments in approximately 2,500 Kmart Corp and other stores, and Footaction, a 444-unit mall-based, branded athletic footwear chain, the company said.

All of the common stock of Footstar is being distributed to Melville shareholders of record as of October 2, 1996 at a ratio of 0.2879 share of Footstar common stock for every one share of Melville common stock held, Melville said.
Footstar shares traded at 20-5/8, off 1/2, on 158,500 shares of volume.

The official distribution date was October 12, 1996, and certificates for Footstar shares will be mailed tomorrow, the company said. Immediately following the distribution, Footstar will have approximately 30.5 million common shares outstanding, the company said.
